sources.transformations: Decode XLSX into UTF-8 compressed CSV; retain every source row and invoice group, add stable worksheet row IDs, normalize date/customer representations, flag anomalies and whole-invoice eligibility, and calculate a profile. Preserve historical dates, quantities and exact decimal price text. See docs/source_mapping.md.
sources.use: Observed historical commercial transactions; not evidence that Acme or its authored employees, payments, shipments and forecasts existed.
